## Root cause (reproduced, not inferred)

`typecheck / lint / unit` red on `main` since the #351 squash (`cdfc26ea`); the push run at
`71e8968e` (43903118795) fails the same job with every downstream leg skipped. Two commits
introduced emissions without the records the checks pin:

- **#351 (270_R6OPS.4):** `apps/api/src/settings-routes.ts` emits `email_taken` (RH-5 —
  409 pre-check + the TOCTOU confirm catch on `user_email_key`); `apps/api/src/
  account-export-routes.ts` emits `enqueue_failed` (RH-19 — send-throw marks the row
  `failed`, answers 503); `packages/db/migrations/0063_pgboss_queue_policies.sql` landed
  without a `check-additive-migrations.test.mjs` `--newer-than 0044` pin row.
- **#356 (275_R6WEB.1):** `apps/web/src/server.ts` `POST /auth/magic-link` emits
  `magic_link_incomplete` (RH-32 — 400 when the POST query carries no `token`).

The REQ-COPY-2 extraction test (`apps/web/src/spa/error-copy.test.ts`) reported exactly
`email_taken` + `enqueue_failed` on the pre-#356 merge head and `magic_link_incomplete`
adds on the post-#356 tree — the check did its job; the emissions outran the inventory.

## Fix

- `apps/web/src/error-copy.ts` — `ERROR_CODES` +3 (sorted append): `email_taken`,
  `enqueue_failed`, `magic_link_incomplete`. `BY_CODE` +2: `email_taken` →
  `S.emailTaken + A.fixAndRetry` (the `/email/` family would mislabel the signed-in
  email-change 409 as a session expiry); `magic_link_incomplete` →
  `S.magicLinkIncomplete + A.signIn` (otherwise generic fallback; sign-in issues a fresh
  link). `enqueue_failed` needs no BY_CODE — the `failed`/`queue` family resolves it to
  `unavailable + tryAgainSoon`, the truthful read (marker marked `failed`; retry re-arms).
- `apps/web/src/copy.ts` — `errors.emailTaken` ("An account with that email already
  exists.") + `errors.magicLinkIncomplete` ("That sign-in link didn't come through
  whole."), sentence+action, never the code.
- `scripts/check-additive-migrations.test.mjs` — pinned `--newer-than` list +1:
  `packages/db/migrations/0063_pgboss_queue_policies.sql` (the R7WRITE.1b append pattern).

No emissions changed, no check weakened, no exemption widened.
